annotations.title: Check a railroad tank car demurrage invoice against your own terms

description: Tank car demurrage invoice check for chemical shippers and receivers. Send the demurrage terms from your tariff or contract (free_hours, daily_rates for day 1, 2, 3 ... of charge, period_rule) and per car when it was placed and released (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, one clock), any excused_hours, and optionally the invoiced_amount. Get back per car the elapsed time, the free time applied, the days charged and the charge the terms give, with the working. With invoiced_amount you get match or differs to the cent, the difference, and which single other reading of the terms (part-days counted or not, calendar days, excused hours ignored, escalating rates ignored, a different free time) would reproduce the invoiced figure. Answer fields: verdict, summary, cars (in your order), reproduced_by, sources, rule, observation, signature; all money is text. Errors: ok false with a message (400 bad input, 413 too large, 429 hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, no request contents stored, signed record. Up to 100 cars per call. Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs in the shipment label are refused; do not send names or account numbers. It does not read your tariff and is not legal or freight-claims advice; your tariff decides.

excused_hours.description: Hours that do not count against you (railroad delay, an outage, an agreed extension); added to the free time. 0 to 99999.99, at most 2 decimals. Default 0.

invoiced_amount.description: To audit: the demurrage amount the railroad invoiced for this car, 0 to 1,000,000,000,000, at most 2 decimals.

label.description: Your own label for the car (a car mark and number is fine).

placed.description: When the car was placed (or became chargeable): YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DD for 00:00. One clock for every time you send.

released.description: When the car was released, same format, not before placed.

shipment_label.description: Your own label for the invoice or shipment (not a person).

daily_rates.description: Charge for the 1st, 2nd, 3rd ... day of demurrage, in order; the last rate repeats for every later day. One entry means a flat daily rate. At most 2 decimals; text keeps it exact.

free_hours.description: Free time in hours per car before demurrage starts, 0 to 99999.99 (e.g. 48).

period_rule.description: any_part_of_a_day (default): a started 24-hour period after free time counts as a day. full_days_only: only completed 24-hour periods count.

tolerance.description: Largest difference in money that still counts as a match, 0 to 1, at most 2 decimals (default 0.01).
